name: Pranayama & Meditation VR
summary:
Make time for your breath.

Pranayama & Meditation VR brings breathing practice, guided meditation, and quiet sitting to Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S.

BUDDHA SANCTUARY
Sit beside a golden Buddha beneath an open sky. Follow turquoise light on inhale and golden light on exhale, or enjoy quiet sitting and a changing day and night atmosphere.

ZEN GARDEN
Follow visual breathing cues among trees, moss, and patterned sand. Balance stones with physics and play harmonic singing bowls.
